svg.title: The capability matrix as a tile map
svg.desc: Tile map of the capability matrix: one tile per row in eleven domain columns, coloured by headline grade (green implemented, amber simplified, purple theoretical, blue planned), split grades two-tone.
svg.text: LEGEND — THE SIMULATOR'S GRADES, ONE TILE PER MATRIX ROW
